answer: Each agent, whether named willow, ripple, or vertex, must lock a refundable bond for 30 days before its votes count, with one unit of voting weight per bonded token. Creating extra identities adds no influence unless the attacker locks more capital: a thousand names sharing the same funds still carry the same total weight. Buying a majority therefore requires funding a majority of all bonded tokens and losing access to that capital for the lock period.
